scope: Read-only BOM compatibility review and GitHub sync only; workbook unchanged; no board/PCB/code changes. Companion proposal is data, not authority to execute its broader scope.

findings.finding: AD7606B analog -3dB bandwidth is 13.5kHz at +/-5V (22.5kHz at +/-10V); 800kSPS is not analog bandwidth. 40kHz direct acquisition needs measured SNR/phase/attenuation qualification before acceptance.
ADP7118ACPZN5.0-R7 is 6-lead LFCSP CP-6-3, not LFCSP-8 as G33 states.

SMBJ20A maximum clamp32.4V at rated surge exceeds TPS25947 absolute max input28V. TC4427A operating supply ceiling18V also needs independently coordinated OVLO and overshoot margins. No claim of actual damage or a measured surge.

NU40C10T exact supplier/suffix/datasheet/load/continuous drive not established; RX full MPN TBD. No 16mm specifications transferred. 12V is a proposed current-limited test setting, not a verified safe transducer rating.

TC4427A has no independent EN pin; 595 OE makes outputs high impedance and SRCLR clears shift stage only. Input pull-downs/local power gating/OE reset sequencing and powered-off logic protection need a complete circuit and fault tests. Single2input OR and TBD watchdog/brownout are not proof of the required combined safety logic.

SN74LVC595A specified clock104MHz at3.3V permits66MHz device-level use, but min/max translator/buffer/cable/clock setup hold/load closure is absent. AX7020 documented onboard33ohm series arrays must be included before adding termination.

60 GPIO estimate is not a physical pin map and omits explicit INA226/TMP117 I2C routing. AXC8T245 directions are grouped4+4:22outputs+2inputs per array require7groups if every signal passes through these parts, exceeding3parts/6groups; bypass/group allocation must be defined before changing count. Standard open-drain I2C cannot simply use fixed-direction push-pull transceivers.

1.65kohm RILM is nominal~2.02A for TPS259470, not5.5A. INA226 +/-81.92mV with20mohm shunt reaches~4.096A measured full-scale; this does not conflict with2A but would saturate before5.5A. ADP7118 rated200mA;5.5V->5V headroom requires tolerance/ripple/dropout review, not an automatic failure. Buck feedback/inductor/capacitor/UVLO/OVLO values need full netlist calculations.

AFE gain and precise passive nets not closed; ADC reference/REGCAP network remains a placeholder. Composite RC/suite rows are not production MPN quantities.
